notes.title: Update Notes for March 24th
notes.content:
Reduced frequency of crashes caused by zombies spawning
Doubled reserve ammo for both shotgun and rifle

notes.title: Update Notes for March 23rd
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the shotgun was firing in full auto ( now fires in semi auto )
Fixed an issue where zombie attacks didn't register when clustered in large groups
Increased damage for both the assault rifle and shotgun
Player now has over 9000 currency at the start of Onslaught mode

Known Issues:
Frequent crashes when a new round starts at the beginning of survival mode
Safe spot in front of the merchant when the platforms are lowered
